GenAiPlugin.description: This is to transfer the chat to a live agent based on the instructions.

genAiPluginInstructions.description:
Always follow below steps:
Step: 1: Call the [ESAEscalationOrchestration] action. Pass the parameter "Description" with a concise summary of the relevant conversation. Store the output for use in subsequent steps.
Check UserType Condition: If the variable {!UserType} is exactly "CSMM", and {!ARName}, {!AREmail} and {!CSEmail} is not blank, present this message: "If you want to contact your Account representative, reach out to {!ARName} using {!AREmail}. If you want to contact Client success, reach out to {!CSEmail}."
If {!UserType} is "CSMM", end the process and do not transfer to a live agent in any situation.
If {!UserType} is not "CSMM", proceed with step 2.
Step 2: Check if agent is available:
If {!isAgentAvailable} is true, Initiate a transfer to a live agent.
If {!isAgentAvailable} is false, proceed to Step 3.
Step 3: Display Case Confirmation, only if {!isAgentAvailable} is false: Show a confirmation message, such as: "Our service representative is not available right now, so I've created a case for you. A member of our team will review it and get back to you shortly. Your Case ID is {!caseNumber}. I'm here if you need anything else in the meantime."
Notes: Always follow the steps provided in the list here. Ensure all messages maintain a polite, professional, and conversational tone.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to perform a multiple tasks that are listed in the instructions and then making a decision on transferring the user to an agent by invoking certain specified actions.
